annotations.title: VVil conſecrate themſelues.
annotations.text: To ſuch as of their owne accord, would bind them ſelues by vow ro certaine thinges not commanded, [1] God preſcribeth a Rule containing three ſpecial obſeruations; not to drincke wine, or aniething that may make drunck; not to cut their haire; and not to touch a dead corps. He appointeth likewiſe rites in making this profeſſion, and calleth the profeſſed Nazareites, that is, ſegregated or ſeparated from the ordinarie ſtate of people: though it was, for moſt part, but for a time, to be limited by the parties them ſelues, and in ſome perpetual, [2]as in Samſon. Iudic. 13. Now vvhat do Nazareites ſignifie, ſaith S. Gregorie (li. 33 c. 23. Moral.) but thoſe that abſtaine, and containe voluntarily from things osherwiſe lawful? [3] As from eating flesh, either for certaine daies and times, or altogether; from Mariage; from proprietie in worldlie goodes; and the like.

notes.text: God prescribed the rule of Nazareites, & the rites of their consecration.
The same was a figure of vowes both temporal and perpetual.
